api-support.purpose: Provide reusable api-support assets shared by auth-owned features and composition seams.
api-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
api-support.justification: api-support centralizes context-local composition that should not duplicate across features.
api-support.createdFor: auth workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
api-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.

social-login-support.purpose: Provide provider-neutral social-login adapter contracts and provider implementations for Auth-owned sign-in and registration journeys.
social-login-support.allowedWhen: Allowed because Google and Facebook provider behavior is shared by sign-in, registration, and API callback composition.
social-login-support.justification: social-login-support keeps provider adapter details out of feature UI and session aggregates while still staying inside the Auth boundary.
social-login-support.createdFor: sign-in and registration Social Login journeys.
social-login-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when social login support is extracted to a dedicated provider contract or no longer spans multiple Auth slices.

ucp-support.purpose: Provide Auth-owned OAuth authorization, token, and revocation routes for UCP identity linking.
ucp-support.allowedWhen: Allowed because UCP OAuth spans the Auth authorization journey and deployable protocol composition.
expectedConsumers: Deployable composition for UCP identity linking
ucp-support.justification: Auth owns the OAuth journey while Identity owns durable linked platform authorization facts.
ucp-support.createdFor: authentication and account-selection for UCP identity linking.
ucp-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when UCP identity linking can move into a single Auth feature slice.
